notes: Generated by vectorize.py, which reads the reference: per-object shading clusters on a mean-shift smoothed copy, each region traced as one part, parts kept by error removed per byte, half-pixel-corrected geometry with self-coloured strokes, and a colour refit from an ownership render. Every path is one shade of one object (bucket, boom, cab, body, tracks, base plate). Needs opencv-python-headless.
